department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale, with section minimums.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL 4.5 (writing 4.5, speaking 4, reading 4, listening 4), IELTS 6.5 (writing 6.0, speaking 6.0)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in writing and speaking.
ielts_min.quote: TOEFL 4.5 (writing 4.5, speaking 4, reading 4, listening 4), IELTS 6.5 (writing 6.0, speaking 6.0)

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed to apply, but you need one to get an offer.
supervisor.quote: A supervisor is not required at the application stage. However, a supervisor is needed to get an offer of admission.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student, international included, gets at least CAD 29,145 a year for four years; internationals also get an award covering the international tuition difference.
funding.quote: Full-time doctoral students (both domestic and international) receive minimum funding of $29,145 per year (effective May 1, 2026) for up to four years.

also.quote: International students in a full-time PhD program will be awarded an International Doctoral Student Award (IDSA)

entry_route.value: A master's with 80% is required; exceptional MASc applicants may be considered for direct PhD entry.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree, an 80% average in coursework and evidence of ability to pursue independent research.

also.quote: Exceptional MASc applicants may be considered for direct-entry to the PhD program from a bachelor’s program.
